CalloutConfig.DispatchText: A bike rider took a tumble and scraped their knee. They need a bandage.
CalloutConfig.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. A bike rider fell and scraped their knee nearby. Please respond to help.
CalloutConfig.EnRouteHelpText: Drive to the yellow marker, then get out and walk up to the rider.
CalloutConfig.OnSceneText: You're on scene. Check on the rider.
CalloutConfig.OnSceneVoiceLine: On scene. Checking on the rider now.
CalloutConfig.AssessmentHelpText: Press E (or X on controller) to help the rider.
CalloutConfig.TreatingText: Cleaning the scrape and putting on a bandage...
CalloutConfig.TreatedText: All better! The scrape is cleaned up and bandaged. Good as new!
CalloutConfig.TransportedText: Just to be safe, the rider gets a checkup at the hospital. Great job!
CalloutConfig.ResolutionVoiceLine: Nice work. The rider is going to be just fine.

Injury.DispatchText: A bike rider scraped their knee and needs a bandage.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. A bike rider scraped their knee nearby. Please respond.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Rider
DialogueLine.Text: I scraped my knee when I fell. It stings a little.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: Easy fix - let me clean it and put a bandage on.

Injury.TreatedText: All better! Knee cleaned up and bandaged. Good as new!

Injury.DispatchText: A bike rider fell and twisted their ankle. They need help.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. A bike rider twisted their ankle nearby. Please respond.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Rider
DialogueLine.Text: I twisted my ankle, it's hard to stand on it.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: Let's get you sitting and wrap that ankle up.

Injury.TreatedText: Nice work - ankle wrapped and the rider feels much better.

Injury.DispatchText: A bike rider took a bad fall and hit their head. May need the hospital.
Injury.DispatchVoiceLine: Dispatch to all units. A bike rider took a bad fall and hit their head nearby. Please respond quickly.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Rider
DialogueLine.Text: I hit my head when I fell... I feel really dizzy.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: Stay still, you'll be okay. We'll get you to the hospital.

Injury.TransportedText: Great job! The rider is safely taken to the hospital for a checkup.

CalloutConfig.PatientThanksText: Thanks! My knee feels much better!
CalloutConfig.ConversationHelpText: Press E (or X on controller) to talk to the rider.

DialogueLine.Speaker: Rider
DialogueLine.Text: Ow, I fell off my bike and scraped my knee.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: That looks sore. Can you stand up okay?

DialogueLine.Speaker: Rider
DialogueLine.Text: Yeah, I can stand. It just stings a bit.

DialogueLine.Speaker: You
DialogueLine.Text: No problem. Let me clean it up and put a bandage on.
